name: Find Agmond
summary: Prospector Ironband has not heard from Prospector Agmond in weeks. Agmond was in charge of the excavation sites in the Badlands, and Ironband wants Agmond found so the report can be collected.

sections.title: A Silent Prospector
sections.body: Agmond ran the excavations in the Badlands, to the southwest. Ironband says "ran" on purpose, for there has been no word from Agmond in weeks. Ironband wants Agmond found, and the report with him. Agmond was last heard of at the farthest-south dig of the Badlands, a small outfit beyond Angor Fortress, and that is where the search should begin.

sections.title: Where the Trail Ends
sections.body: At the end of the search you find a skeleton, which must be what is left of Agmond. The body is broken and battered, and the bones have been picked clean.

faq.answer: Agmond ran the excavations in the Badlands, southwest of Prospector Ironband.

faq.q: Why is Prospector Ironband looking for Agmond?
faq.answer: Ironband has not heard from Agmond in weeks and wants to get Agmond's report.

faq.q: Where was Prospector Agmond last known to be?
faq.answer: At the farthest-south dig of the Badlands, a small outfit beyond Angor Fortress.
